mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, menu_name, screen_id, url, icon, business_category, description, use_status FROM menu WHERE use_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY display_order, menu_name
SELECT menu_id, menu_name, screen_id, url, icon, business_category, description, use_status FROM menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET menu_name = #{menuName}, screen_id = #{screenId}, url = #{url}, icon = #{icon}, business_category = #{businessCategory}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'
